content: Ligand 1 derives to jnk3 0.06, the highest in this pool, and the reason is visible: it is an N-aryl urea on an aniline, so it has one conjugated aryl-N-H already. But its SA is 3.24 because of the fused bicyclic aminal, and there is no azine anywhere. Atom 0 is one of its dimethylamino methyls over an acyclic bond, so I keep that carbon and discard the other 24. Continuing the azine sweep: having tested pyrimidin-2-yl, where both ring nitrogens flank the carbon bearing the N-H, this episode takes pyrimidin-4-yl, where only one nitrogen is ortho to the donor and the second sits meta to it. That separates two things the 2-isomer confounds - whether a second ring nitrogen helps at all, and whether it has to be adjacent to the donor. The surviving methyl goes to the position para to the ortho nitrogen and meta to the N-H, matching where a substituent pays on pyridine, and the meta anilide and cyclobutyl cap are unchanged. Expected product: about 282 Da.
